name: arcextension
description: Curator client: reports tab activity snapshots and executes curator commands (§5, §6).
//key: Fixes the extension id independent of the load path (§6). Replace this PLACEHOLDER with the real public key of the signing keypair at packaging time; the value below is not a real key and must be regenerated per deployment.
//host_permissions: TWO patterns, not one: in Chromium match-patterns ws/wss are distinct schemes and the https pattern does NOT cover a wss request (§6). <host> is a deploy-time placeholder stamped by the instance generator (§13). <all_urls> is deliberately NOT requested here — it is only for execute_js and is added in that phase (least privilege).
